The Bandits of Kumarahaz

I've met an agent of the Imperial Legion in Tel Branora, a Bruccius Valius,  he's apparently on a mission to track down a dangerous group of bandits that's threatening trade in the region. The locals haven't been giving him much help though, and without a starting point, he doesn't know where to begin searching. I've agreed to act as an intermediary with the locals, maybe I can persuade them to talk to me instead.

Nireli Farys, the shipmaster in Tel Branora, has told me that the bandits I'm looking for can be found in the caverns of Kumarahaz, on a small isle to the northeast of Tel Branora. Apparently they're anti-Imperial separatists, being co-led by one Sathdira and one Biiril, and they're heavily armed. If I go looking for them, I should expect a fight, but first I should report back to Bruccius Valius with what I've found.

I've informed Bruccius Valius of what I know regarding the bandits of Kumarahaz. He gave me a bag of gold as a reward, and asked me to help him take down the leaders of this bandit cell, but I've declined. I don't know if I want to further involve myself with this whole affair.

I've agreed to help Bruccius Valius eliminate the bandit threat in Kumarahaz. When I'm ready, I should meet him at the cavern entrance, and together we'll find and put an end to these troublesome outlaws.

Bruccius Valius has asked me to enter the caverns of Kumarahaz with two objectives; to kill the leaders of this bandit group, Sathdira and Biiril, and to find an Imperial log book believed to be in the bandits possession. When I've accomplished these tasks, I should see Valius for a reward, but I may want to ask around with the locals of Tel Branora for additional insights about Kumarahaz first.

I've informed Bruccius Valius that I've killed the bandit leaders in Kumarahaz. He was naturally thrilled that they've been dealt with, but was disappointed to learn that I hadn't retrieved the Imperial log book that was in their possession. Should I find the log book, Bruccius has promised a generous reward for it.

I've met Bruccius Valius at the entrance to Kumarahaz. He managed to take on a few of the bandits by himself, but I've told him to wait outside while I deal with the bandits inside Kumarahaz. I feel more comfortable doing this alone, without a loud, aggressive, Imperial charging ahead of me.
The archers guarding the way into Kumarahaz are dead, we can now begin our assault on the bandit stronghold. Bruccius Valius has agreed to follow my lead from here on out.

The bandit leaders of Kumarahaz have been slain, and with them the threat to Imperial trade in this region. Bruccius has given a small pile of gold for my part in defeating these bandits, but he's still looking for that log book. If I should find it, I should return it to him for a sizable bounty.
I've informed Bruccius Valius of what I know regarding the bandits of Kumarahaz, but I'm done, I don't wish to get involved any further with this bandit business.
I've returned to Bruccius Valius and let him know that I won't be joining him on his mission to eliminate the bandits of Kumarahaz. He'll be going in alone, but I'm sure he can handle himself.

I've discovered the body of Bruccius Valius in the caverns of Kumarahaz. He managed to smash through their defenses, but not without injury, and he apparently died from his wounds. I wonder how things might have gone differently had I joined him on his assault?

Bruccius Valius has died, and with him, his quest to end the bandit threat around Tel Branora. Perhaps I could still take care of the bandits myself, but without Bruccius, I doubt there'll be any additional rewards for doing so. Though, I imagine the bandits must have some treasure...

Bruccius Valius has died in combat fighting the bandits of Kumarahaz. While I could continue the fight in his stead, I doubt I'll get a reward for doing so. Of course, I imagine the bandits probably have some loot, ripe and ready for the taking...

I've informed Bruccius Valius that I've killed the bandit leaders in Kumarahaz, and I gave him the Imperial log book that was in their possession. He was naturally quite pleased, and more than a little impressed that I managed to take care of the problem on my own.  As a reward, he gave me an enchanted blade, a pile of gold, and a promise to pass along my part in all this to his superiors in the Imperial Legion.

I've given Bruccius Valius the Imperial log book he was seeking, and he's rewarded me generously with a pile of gold and an enchanted blade. With the bandits dead and the log book in hand, he'll be returning to his superiors, and he's promised to put in a good word for me with the Imperial Legion. Perhaps I'll see him again someday?

I've informed Bruccius Valius that I've killed the bandit leaders in Kumarahaz, and I gave him the Imperial log book that was in their possession. He was naturally quite pleased, and more than a little surprised that I had already taken care of the problem. As a reward, he gave me an enchanted blade, a pile of gold, and a promise to pass along my part in all this to his superiors in the Imperial Legion.

I really can't thank you enough for dealing with those bandits, I can't believe you were able to handle them all on your own! You're an inspiration %PCName, I hope we'll get a chance to work together again in the future!

Let me get a closer look at that...Yes, this is it! Well done, %PCName! That's the last piece of the puzzle to the bandit threat here, I'll need to return this to my superiors. But in the meantime, here, you've more than earned this. It's been a pleasure working with you, %PCName!
Keep looking for it, it has to be in those caverns somewhere!
%PCName, any luck tracking down that log book? The information contained in those logs could pose a serious security threat to trade in the region if left unaccounted for.

You are a marvel, %PCName, you know that? With this log book in hand, the threat to Imperial trade in these waters has been eliminated. The Legion owes you a debt of thanks, I'll be sure to put in a good word with my superiors about you. But for now, here, take this, you've more than earned it.

Ah, that's a shame, as long as that log book is out there, it could still cause disruptions to Imperial trade, even with the bandit threat eliminated. If you do find it, bring it back to me for a reward.

Excellent work, %PCName! I'll admit, I had my doubts when you said you wanted to do this alone, but I'm impressed! Taking on a whole bandit encampment by yourself is no easy feat, I wish we had more soldiers with your capabilities! Here, you've more than earned this. Now, tell me, did you find that Imperial log book?
Ah, well I don't want to rush you %PCName, but every moment those bandits remain alive, they pose a risk to every trading vessel in these waters. Report back when you've dealt with them.
Tell me, have the bandits been taken care of, are their leaders dead?

Well, here I was preparing to go in all alone and you've already done the job! Good work, %PCName, you're a credit to the Empire! Here, I think you've definitely earned this! Without their leaders, those bandits won't pose much of a threat - provided, of course, you did find that Imperial log book, didn't you?
Well, I won't lie, I'm disappointed, I could've used your help %PCName. No sense delaying now though, I'll head to Kumarahaz and deal with these bandits myself.

Oh-ho, looking to fight them all by yourself? Well, if that's what you want, I can't stop you, but be prepared for a fight. And if you're going in alone, ask around about Kumarahaz first, maybe some of the locals know something that'll give you an advantage. I'll wait here for your return.
Good to hear, %PCName! It'll be a tough battle, so if you need to gather supplies, do so now. I'll meet you at the entrance to Kumarahaz and together we'll put an end to this little bandit rebellion!

Yes, these bandits must be dealt with, they cannot be allowed to interfere with trade, there must be repercussions. If I must go in alone, I will, but if you're ready to come with me, I would appreciate an extra blade.

Ha! You've managed to preempt me every step of the way, %PCName, I am impressed! Here, you've more than earned this! Now that the threat has been dealt with, I need to report back to my superiors, but rest assured %PCName, I'll be giving you credit for a job well done!

What? You've already killed them?! Truly, you are a wonder %PCName, to single-handedly end this bandit threat is no small feat! Here, you've more than earned this reward, the Imperil Legion is in your debt! I don't suppose you also found that Imperial log book while you were in there, did you?
I'm sorry to hear that, %PCName, you've been quite an asset so far. If you change your mind, I'll be here for a couple more days, but beyond that, I'll be going in with or without you.

Looking to keep the glory for yourself, eh? I can respect that, but this won't be an easy battle, %PCName. If you're going in alone, you should ask the locals what they know about Kumarahaz, maybe they'll have some insights that'll prove advantageous. I'll wait here for your return.
That's the spirit! Expect a tough fight, so if you need to gather some supplies first, I'll be waiting at the entrance to Kumarahaz. Come find me when you're ready for battle!
In addition, I suspect they may have an Imperial log book in their possession. We'll need to retrieve it, it cannot be allowed to remain in enemy hands. So, what do you say %PCName?
Alright, I suppose I can't ask any more of you, %PCName, you did what I asked and I can take it from here. I'll make short work of the bandits of Kumarahaz.

Locating the bandits was only the first step, but our options out here are fairly limited. As I've said, the Imperial Legion is stretched thin, I doubt we can expect many, if any, reinforcements to take on this separatist group. If this group is as big as you say, I'll need your help in eliminating their leaders. Cut off the heads, and the threat will be as good as gone.

Kumarahaz you say? Excellent work, %PCName! Now that we know where they are, we can root them out and send a message that interference with Imperial trade will not be tolerated! Here's a little something for your troubles, but if you're willing, I could still use your help again.

Yes, these bandits pose a serious threat to Imperial trade in the region, and we cannot let that threat go unanswered. Tell me, what have you learned? Did the locals tell you who they were? Where their base is?
Please return to me when you've learned more, we cannot allow these bandits to jeopardize trade in the region..

Like I already told you, they're hiding out in the caverns of Kumarahaz on a little isle to the north-east of here. Shouldn't be hard to find, just look for a cavern with signs of habitation around the entrance.

I'm only telling you this because, unlike that Imperial agent, I like you, and I trust you more than the Empire. But if you're going into Kumarahaz, you better be prepared, those bandits are dangerous and fanatical, you won't be able to reason with them.

Oh, I know the group you're talking about, Sathdira and Biiril's group, they've got a hideout in the caverns of Kumarahaz on a small isle to the northeast. They're separatists, they want nothing more than to kick the Empire out of Morrowind. Honestly, I'm not unsympathetic, but their attacks on trade ships are bad for business. We need those supplies, and once this area gets a reputation for piracy, there'll be less demand for my services, and that's bad for me.
I overheard Sovi in the tavern say she was picking up supplies for an armed group somewhere. Might be the bandits you're looking for, I think she headed off somewhere to the northeast.
I heard Biiril Terilu was leading a group of separatists near here. Good for him, I say, we don't need Imperial authority in Morrowind.
Sorry, I haven't heard anything about that, I can't help you.
I can't leave until I have something to report on this nearby bandit activity, so if you change your mind, and want to earn a little easy gold, you know where to find me.

Talk to the locals, figure out where the bandits are hiding and then report back to me. Given the size of the raid, we're most likely looking for a large, well equipped and well organized group. There can't be too many places around here for a group like that to hide, and they'd need to bring in supplies from the outside. Someone must know something, find out what and where, and then we can discuss next steps.
Yes, that group of bandits is still out there, and I still need information. If you're willing to help, I could use the assistance.

Look, I can't promise you riches, but I can promise you'd be doing the Empire a favor and you would be paid for your service. If you change your mind, I'll be here trying to find the whereabouts of these vagabonds.

Maybe it's the uniform, devil knows the Telvanni don't much care for Imperial authority, or maybe my skills at persuasion are lacking, but I need help in tracking these bandits down and maybe, just maybe, you'll have better luck than me.

We believe this brazen attack was carried out by bandits somewhere in this region, but we don't know where exactly. I was sent to meet with Mistress Therana and gain the support of the Telvanni in rooting them out, but they've been less than cooperative. Mistress Therana has outright refused to meet with me, and the locals haven't been much help either.

But when bandits start threatening the flow of trade and commerce, that's when we're forced to step in and put a swift end to these miscreants. A few days ago, an Imperial trade ship sailing down the Inner Sea was intercepted and raided by an armed group of Dunmer bandits. They stole the cargo, cut down or captured most of the crew, and set the vessel ablaze.

Yes, bandits are a frequent problem out here in the provinces, especially here in Morrowind. The Legion is stretched too thin to deal with most of them, and so long as they don't cause too much trouble, we're content to leave them to the local authorities.
Keep searching, %PCName, it must be in there somewhere.

Absolutely stunning work, %PCName! With those bandits dealt with and the log book in hand, we can finally rest easy. You've done the Empire and the Legion a great service, I'll be sure to make mention of your efforts to my superiors, and you've more than earned this reward!

I'm impressed by your initiative %PCName, with their leaders gone, the rest of the bandits will scatter. But we need that log book. Here's something for your troubles, but there's more where that came from if you can bring me the log book from Kumarahaz.
Well? How did your venture into the caverns go? Did you kill the bandit leaders? Have you retrieved the log book?

Ah, well I don't want to rush you %PCName, but every moment those bandits remain alive, they pose a risk to every trading vessel in these waters. I'll continue to wait here for now, but sooner or later, we need to act.

Aye, as I've told you, %PCName, that's where those bandits are holed up. The caverns are large and deep, with vast underwater reservoirs and submerged tunnels. I think some of the tunnels even open out to the sea. I've seen some dark looking crevices beneath the waves sailing out there. Don't know if they're part of the same cavern system, but if they are, that could give you a back way in, provided you have some means of breathing water.
Kumarahaz? I know of it, it's a cavern on a small isle to the northeast. Never been there myself, I heard it was occupied by bandits.

The caverns? I've been there a few times, long ago. They go down pretty deep, and more than a few of the tunnels are submerged. If you're looking to get your feet wet, I'd bring a few water breathing potions. No telling how deep some of those tunnels go.
Oh, good to see you %PCName, I'm on my way out, just taking one last look before I depart. I'll have to file a thorough report when I get back.
%PCName, good to see you! I'm getting ready to depart, but I have time to chat if you're in the mood.
Well, it must be around here somewhere, keep looking! We can't just leave something that valuable lying about.

Ah, there you are %PCName, I was just admiring these caverns, quite the place aren't they? No wonder these outlaws holed up here, it's a rather lovely place to set up camp. But anyway, have you retrieved that log book yet?

Did you finish the fight without me? I'm impressed, good job %PCName! With those bandits dead, there's nothing stopping us from searching for that log book. But I'll leave the looting to you, %PCName, just come find me if you find where that book is. Ah, and of course, here's your share of the bounty for taking down those bandits!

Ho, that was a fun fight wasn't it? That's two for two, now all we need is that log book and we can get out of here. I'll leave the looting to you, %PCName, just come back and find me when you've found that book. Ah, and I almost forgot, here's your share of the bounty for putting an end to those bandits. There's more where that came, so hurry back with that book, alright?
[Bruccius tries to say something, but all that comes out are gurgles. Maybe trying to talk to him underwater isn't the best idea?]
Okay, I'll wait here, but don't take too long! There's still bandits about!
Right, let's go then.
%PCName, are you ready to continue?

Ha, that's one down! These bandits aren't so tough after all, eh? We're not done yet though, we still need to find their other leader, and that log book. But if you need to stop and rest, we can wait a while. What say you, %PCName? Shall we continue?
We can't rest until the bandits of Kumarahaz have been dealt with %PCName. So, what's the plan? Do you want me to wait here while you scout ahead or should we keep moving?
Good job, %PCName, with the path cleared, we should have a straight shot into their lair. I'll follow your lead from here on out, let's take care of these pesky bandits!
Did you find the key? Ah, well, no matter, the archers are dead, so we can take our time. I'll follow your lead from here, if you don't mind.
Ah, you've got the key, but looks like the archers have already been dealt with. Well, I'll follow you from now on, lead the way.
Come and get me, you fetchers! %PCName, quick, unlock the gate!
Ah, is that the key? Great, follow me then, I'll draw their attention while you come in from behind! Charge!
%PCName, any luck finding that key? No? Well, keep searching then, I don't want to charge into that deathtrap with no way to get through. They must keep a spare somewhere.

This is quite the lair, isn't it %PCName? I don't think I've ever seen so many mushrooms! But careful, they've got a gate up ahead and archers guarding the way. I'll bet you a hundred drakes that gate is locked, we're going to need a key to get in. Why don't you scout around down that side passage and see if you can't find a key? I'll hold the fort here.
%PCName, any luck tracking down that book? I know those bandits must have kept it, so it should be somewhere in the caverns of Kumarahaz.
Ah, you're back from the caverns of Kumarahaz, how did you fare? It looks like you're still alive, at least, but what about the bandits? Do they still breathe?
I'll see you inside, %PCName.

You want to take them on by yourself? You're a brave one, %PCName, but I hope you know what you're getting into. There's far more of them inside, and probably better equipped than the ones we faced out here. But if you think you can take them, I'll wait here, just let me know when the job is done.
Great, I'll see you inside %PCName.

Good of you to join me, %PCName! As you can see, I've already had a bit of a run-in with our bandit friends. They must've been expecting us. You can be sure there's more inside. Ready to begin our assault?
Why, if it isn't the bandit slayer! Always a pleasure to see you, %PCName. I was about to report back to my superiors, but I'm more than happy to chat for a bit.
Sorry, %PCName, I don't have time to chat just now, I'm preparing to head into the caverns of Kumarahaz and deal with these bandits myself.
%PCName, you've returned! Have you found that Imperial log book yet?
%PCName, you've returned! Have you been to the caverns of Kumarahaz yet? Are the bandits dead?
You've returned, I wasn't sure you would. Have you changed your mind? Will you help me deal with these bandits? I'll be leaving soon, so if you're coming with, you need to tell me now.
%PCName, tell me, have you learned anything new about these bandits? Have you discovered their location?

Greetings stranger, from the looks of you, you're not from around here are you? Neither am I, but perhaps we can help each other out? I'm an Imperial agent on the hunt for a dangerous group of bandits that are reportedly operating in this area, but the locals won't talk to me, perhaps you'd have better luck?
